PROVENANCE, read before trusting this file.
Two real games from the real 2026-07-30 1910_6g slate, in the render mlb.com
produces when only the HOME side has posted. Every token below is verbatim from
that slate's own artifacts: the club lines, records, clocks, venues, pitcher
lines and team headers are copied from data/slates/2026-07-30/paste_1910_6g_v2.txt,
and the CIN and SD batting orders are copied from
data/slates/2026-07-30/paste_home_sides.txt, which is Ben's second paste of the
same slate taken after those two home sides posted.
What is RECONSTRUCTED rather than captured is the interleaving: paste_home_sides
was hand-reordered during the build so the posted club led, which made both
game_ids read backwards against the salary file. This file restores mlb.com's
away-then-home order around the same real content, per the render documented in
docs/backlog_inbox 2026-07-30. It is labelled reconstructed because it is, and
because calling it a capture would be the kind of claim this project does not make.
